attachments.text: The Women in Machine Learning & Data Science (WiMLDS) Meetup aims to inspire, educate, regardless of gender, and support women and gender minorities in the field. And 20th edition will occur at CRI! Of course, all genders may attend the meetup. Agenda • Introduction by CRI & the Paris WiMLDS team • "Reconstruction of ecological interaction networks" by Raphaëlle Momal, PhD Candidate @AgroParisTech • "From spatial complexity to real estate prices: statistical and stochastic models" by Sarah Soleiman-Halevy, PhD Candidate @MAEngineers • Panel discussion about "Education: when Machine Learning helps Human Learning" led by Marie Sacksick, PhD Candidate @Domoscio The...
